subject: External webhook integration
task: Harden carrier webhook as runnable local HTTP+SQLite integration using README contract. Verify exact raw signed bytes and timestamp freshness; reject malformed/unknown payloads and bound request-body work. Valid north-scoped order.shipped may transition only north orders. Persist event identity and its local effect atomically before acknowledgement. Identical event bytes replay successfully without a second effect; conflicting id reuse rejects. Invalid signature, stale/future timestamp, unknown type, wrong-tenant order, oversized body and precommit failure cannot mutate state. Keep safe responses and document error/retry/retention limits. Verify real loopback HTTP and file-backed SQLite including restart. Operations asks whether these can run as MCP tools: state actual support and missing runtime/adapter work; do not invent or implement MCP server. Do not contact live carrier. Use native Node 24.12+ SQLite/built-ins, no downloads/live deployment. Put implementation and verification in trial/artifact and write trial/result.json; classify all L01-L24 proportionally.

requirements.meaning: Signature verifies exact raw contract within bounded timestamp window without malformed-input bypass.
Payload/body validation, tenant authorization and safe responses bound denial/failure paths.
Durable event identity binds parameters; local mutation/receipt is atomic before acknowledgement.
Duplicate/restart/conflicting deliveries and injected precommit fault have defined durable outcomes.
Real HTTP/file-backed evidence is retained and absent MCP runtime is truthfully unsupported.
All 24 coverage dispositions and requirement/mechanism/limit/failure/verification chains are proportionate and truthful.
